purpose: Decide whether the retained BNR domestic-primary-market government-securities issuance boundary can replace the generic government_debt_issuance node in the existing closed candidate issuance-yield loop without inventing causal bridges or collapsing distinct government financing concepts.

conceptual_topology.interpretation: The conceptual signed path may remain a qualitative closed candidate. Its empirically materialisable boundary is not closed merely because one exact issuance source is now retained.

retained_bnr_boundary.source: National Bank of Romania, Monthly Bulletin — December 2025, table 12.2
retained_bnr_boundary.scope: Domestic primary-market government securities, new and roll-over issues, preserving instrument and currency distinctions.

official_financing_boundary_evidence.ministry_source: Romanian Ministry of Finance — Romania Investor Presentation, March 2025; Indicative Financing Programme 2025
official_financing_boundary_evidence.finding: Government gross financing requirements are allocated across multiple domestic and external channels. Domestic financing includes interbank auctions and retail programmes; external financing includes Eurobonds/private placements and official-sector loan/disbursement channels.

bnr_yield_boundary_evidence.finding: BNR table 12.2 reports issue volumes together with instrument- and currency-specific primary-market yields or interest rates. It does not provide one scalar generic sovereign_yield for the feedback node.

required_bridges_before_any_closed_empir.requirement: Preregister and validate how gross financing need is allocated across interbank domestic securities, retail, external securities, private placements, RRF/EC financing, IFI loans and other relevant channels.

Define and validate a supply-pressure observable or transform. Raw gross issuance volume alone must not be relabelled supply pressure; market depth, investor absorption, maturity/currency composition or another preregistered denominator/structure may be required.
Freeze the exact instrument, currency and maturity boundary or an ex-ante aggregation rule. Do not average heterogeneous issue yields post hoc to manufacture a generic scalar yield.
Specify debt-stock propagation through maturity, refinancing and re-fixing structure; a new-issue yield is not contemporaneously equal to the interest cost on the outstanding debt stock.

next_empirical_task.scope: Materialise the instrument- and currency-specific 2025 primary-market yield/rate observations already present in retained BNR table 12.2, preserving missing/not-applicable cells and without constructing a generic sovereign-yield aggregate.

next_gate_after_materialisation: Reconcile the exact RON auction-universe stock denominator before any supply-load ratio is computed. Submitted-bids and bid-to-cover monthly series remain blocked because the monthly report exposes them graphically without reproducible native-text month/series mapping.
